events.intent: Age out a reviewer verdict stuck in the INCOMPLETE state: fail and escalate once after a bound or when the reviewer pane is idle.

risks: AO_REVIEW_INCOMPLETE_BOUND_MS defaults to 120s; a reviewer whose provider takes longer than that to finish printing a very long verdict on a slow terminal could be aged out before it actually finishes. The pane-idle path is unaffected by this since it only fires once the composer is actually empty.

Idle detection depends on providerDirs finding the provider's adapter JSON (needs pluginRoot, consumer, or home to resolve a providers directory); if none resolve, idle detection silently degrades to always-false and only the time bound applies, which is a safe (non-escalating) fallback, not a failure.
